data.one_liner: Classic CSV parsers suitable for most use cases with experimental event-based streaming.
data.what_it_does: Parses CSV data from strings or streams with good performance. Supports configurable field separators and event-based streaming parsing to handle large datasets efficiently.
use_when: You need to parse CSV files or strings in Dart or Flutter.
You require event-based streaming parsing for large datasets to manage memory efficiently.
avoid_when: You need to write CSV data back out (only parsing is described).
strengths: Supports experimental event-based streaming parsing for large files.
weaknesses: Does not include CSV serialization/writing features.
